Maison.title: Maison Soleil: digital at the level of the place
Maison.lead: Andrew Gee has run Maison Soleil in the Seychelles since 2009. The retreat had presence. The website did not.
story: For years it relied on an outdated site and third-party booking platforms. Online, the brand did not match the place.
We rebuilt the foundation: a professional website, a clear inquiry and direct booking path, and practical automation so interest does not go cold.
In this case, that also reduced platform dependence and brought the guest relationship closer to the owner. An outcome of this brief — not the only kind of work I do.
Maison.shift: A digital presence at the level of Maison Soleil, with a clear path to inquire and book direct.

points.label: Before
points.text: Outdated site, weak presence, and heavy platform dependence.

points.label: After
points.text: Presence at the level of the retreat, a clearer booking path, and a system the team can use.

points.label: In practice
points.text: Guests can discover, inquire, and book on maisonsoleil.info — with WhatsApp to Andrew.
